definitions.explanation: The very highest or most important. Almost always used as a modifier before another noun to indicate that something is of the utmost level or importance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{至上|しじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧だ。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{顧客|こきゃく}{満足|まんぞく}→顧客満足：24860_kokyakumanzoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{至上|しじょう}⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This company treats customer satisfaction as its supreme directive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{至上|しじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧で⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦そのため→そのため：08500_sonotame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すべて⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{犠牲|ぎせい}→犠牲：14743_gisei⟧にしてきた。
examples.english: For him, victory was the supreme joy, and he sacrificed everything for it.

notes:
Almost always used as a prefix-like modifier before a noun, not as a standalone predicate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {至上|しじょう}⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧ (supreme command/directive)
- {至上|しじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧ (supreme joy)
- {至上|しじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧ (supreme objective)
- {至上|しじょう}⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧ (supremacism — as in a doctrine)

Note the many homophones: ⟦{史上|しじょう}→史上：11806_shijou⟧ (in history), ⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧ (market), and ⟦{試乗|しじょう}→試乗：08448_shijou⟧ (test drive) are all pronounced the same but written with different kanji.
